Eastside Tours Evening Ride

Bellevue, WA · Road

Eastside Tours Evening Ride is a road group ride in Bellevue, WA. It rolls every Thursday at 6:20 pm from Crossroads Park, east parking lot (enter off 164th). About 25 miles, brisk, 16-18 mph on the flat; mellow on flats, hills at your own pace; about 1,500 ft of climbing.

For visitors

Front and rear lights required once it's dark. Free, but register on Cascade's site and attend the safety briefing. Go/no-go call is made at 4:20 pm on rough weather. A hilly ride.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:20 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 16-18 mph: brisk — you'll want some fitness. It splits into pace groups. Pick the slowest one your first time; you can move up next week.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Eastside Tours Evening Ride group ride

A Thursday evening Cascade free group ride around the Eastside, with a different route each week and about 25 miles with 1,500 feet of climbing. It's brisk on the flat and climbs are at your own pace. First ride of each month finishes at Chipotle.
